base_amendment.policy: This append-only addendum supersedes the old implementation, renderer, selector, canonicalization, and formal-path sections. Dataset identity, benchmark hashes, numeric N/A, count N/R, and fixed-dataset-not-generation boundaries remain in force.

scope.paper_label: PhysX-Mobility prompt-only CLIP retrieval (fixed-dataset reference; not generation)
scope.primary_report: eligible render coverage, selected artifact coverage, and retrieval reproducibility

benchmark.selector_prompt_policy: The pre-prompt launcher verifies the exact frozen source rows and projects exact strings/order to the locked prompt-only file. The selector reads only that two-field file and never reads the full benchmark rows, specs, protocol contents, amendment, audit, source metadata, or scorer.

dataset_and_provenance.license: CC-BY-NC-4.0 from the official Hugging Face dataset API
dataset_and_provenance.license_boundary: The pinned local archive contains no license text. The dataset license is externally verified; the official code-repository license is separate.
dataset_and_provenance.native_object_render_coverage: 0/2024; JPG/PNG files in the release are textures, not precomputed object views

private_source_gate.archive_extraction: Reject absolute, parent, dot, non-normalized, duplicate-normalized, and symlink ZIP members. Require exact regular-file path-set equality and stream SHA-256 byte equality for every ZIP/extracted file.

zero_pose_invariant.consequence: Direct raw-OBJ visual composition is geometry-equivalent to official q=0 URDF visual geometry for this pinned cohort.

private_source_gate.exact_private_closure: Before and after source lock, require the exact top-level file/directory set. geometry_scenes must equal the render-plan set; geometry_blobs must equal the complete set referenced by all scenes; every item is regular non-symlink and every bound hash matches. The shared builder independently repeats this closure gate before rendering.
private_source_gate.selector_forbidden_private_data: source identities and paths, URDF/XML, finaljson contents, link/joint/visual names, category, dimensions, raw geometry, and source binding

official_evidence.rule: R_x(+pi/2) is the official fixed preprocessing rotation.

camera_frame.application: camera_frame maps source coordinates to the shared canonical camera coordinates. The renderer maps canonical camera and light poses back by inverse(camera_frame); mesh vertices, visual transforms, and q=0 URDF transforms remain byte/numerically unchanged.

shared_renderer.framing: orthographic half-frame 1.15 times canonical AABB half-diagonal; camera radius 3.2, znear 0.01, and zfar 8.0 times the same half-diagonal
shared_renderer.appearance: white background; base RGBA (0.56,0.62,0.68,1); metallic 0; roughness 0.78; double-sided; smooth false; ambient RGB (0.42,0.42,0.42); one camera-aligned directional light intensity 2.6; RGB PNG compress level 9
shared_renderer.nonblank_gate: Each view must contain at least 32 pixels with any RGB channel below 250.
shared_renderer.replay: All candidate inventory rows, every PNG byte/hash, and worker runtime fingerprint must be identical across both fresh full renders.

selector_visible_contract_forbidden_fiel: full benchmark rows, specs, scorer, or prior outputs
shared_selection.aggregation: float32 CLIP per-view features converted to float64; L2-normalize each of 8 views; arithmetic mean; L2-normalize; exact prompt feature converted and normalized in float64
shared_selection.selection: global top-1 over all 2024 eligible opaque candidates; no category filter
shared_selection.tie_break: descending exact float64 score, then ascending opaque candidate key
shared_selection.replay: asset/text embeddings, token/index metadata, and 18-row selections must be byte-identical
shared_selection.atomic_publish: Build the complete selection bundle in a same-filesystem staging directory located outside the formal root, write the selection lock last inside staging, then perform one directory rename to formal_root/selection_bundle.

units_materialization_and_reporting.canonicalizer_contract: geometry scale 1.0 preserves raw released coordinates; artifact metric_eligible=false, numeric_constraint_status=N/A, coordinate_units=dataset_units_metric_binding_unestablished, and only dataset-unit bounds/extents fields are allowed; unit_scale_to_m and any *_m metric field are forbidden
units_materialization_and_reporting.hierarchy: Copy the exact selected source URDF and complete partseg tree and preserve source mesh-bearing link/visual names in semantic nodes.
units_materialization_and_reporting.selected_failure_policy: The locked rank-1 source is attempted once. Failure remains failure; no rank fallback and no repair.
units_materialization_and_reporting.count_reason: Source l_N link identifiers are structural and have no frozen mapping to Table 4 semantic roles.
units_materialization_and_reporting.atomic_publish: Write the entire materialization bundle and lock in a same-filesystem staging directory outside the formal root, then perform one rename to formal_root/materialization_bundle.

pre_result_gate.audit_must_bind: this exact addendum SHA, report SHA, and all implementation SHA fields
